name: get_data_catalog
description: Explain what GETWAB can research and list its official federal procurement datasets in plain language. Use when the user asks what this app can do, what data it covers, or where to search.

name: plan_research
description: Classify a natural-language federal procurement question and plan the required single- or cross-dataset research workflow.

name: analyze_awards
description: Run a validated, read-only FPDS aggregation for spending, award counts, vendors, incumbents, competitors, agencies, NAICS, or PSC. Prefer this over text search for totals, trends, rankings, comparisons, or fiscal-year questions.

name: search_awards
description: Search paginated historical FPDS federal contract awards by PIID, agency, vendor, CAGE, UEI, or exact structured NAICS/PSC filters. Use analyze_awards with group_by=market for spending, agency, vendor, and trend analysis.

name: search_opportunities
description: Search paginated current or archived SAM.gov contract opportunities using keywords and status. For "all" requests, continue through next_page or disclose partial coverage.

name: match_opportunities
description: Find paginated federal opportunities matching a company profile supplied as text or extracted from a capability statement. Returned candidates are not proof of eligibility or win probability.

name: search_vendors
description: Search paginated federal contractors and summarize their FPDS obligations, actions, agencies, NAICS, and PSC activity. Do not infer ownership from name similarity.

name: search_entities
description: Search SAM.gov entity registrations with an explicit match mode and pagination. Never infer a corporate-family relationship from a name match. For "all" requests, continue through next_page or disclose partial coverage.

name: search_exclusions
description: Search paginated official SAM.gov exclusion records by name, UEI, CAGE, agency, type, and lifecycle status. Do not infer a clean record when coverage is incomplete.

name: search_subcontracts
description: Search paginated reported federal contract subawards by subcontractor, prime, UEI, PIID, agency, NAICS, or keywords. Do not infer relationships from names alone.

name: search_subnet_opportunities
description: Search current SBA SUBNet subcontracting opportunity listings published by prime contractors. These are open leads, not awarded subcontracts.

psc.description: Requested PSC used for relevance review; SBA SUBNet does not publish a structured PSC field.

name: search_subcontracting_plans
description: Search SBA annual prime-contractor directory records associated with subcontracting plans. Directory presence is not an open opportunity or an awarded subcontract.

name: search_acquisition_forecasts
description: Search federal agency acquisition forecasts for planned requirements, expected solicitations and awards, agencies, offices, NAICS/PSC codes, set-asides, values, and reported incumbents. Forecasts are planning signals, not solicitations or awards.

name: search_gsa_contracts
description: Search the GSA eLibrary contract directory by vendor, UEI, contract number, category, geography, availability, and socioeconomic designation.

name: search_assistance_subawards
description: Search reported federal assistance subawards, including grants and cooperative-agreement flow-downs. Do not confuse assistance subawards with procurement contract subawards.

name: search_archived_opportunities
description: Search archived SAM.gov opportunity notices and historical solicitation versions to research how a requirement appeared previously. These records are not current open opportunities.

name: research_vendor
description: Run a cross-dataset vendor investigation across FPDS history, SAM entities, SAM exclusions, and contract subawards.
